title: MCP tool-argument policy (metadata-only)
description: AIM-664: express allow / deny / confirm on MCP tool name + argument *shape* (key presence and value *type class* only). This is NOT a license to store or inspect argument content. Value equality, substrings of values, paths, URLs, bodies, and argv are privacy-blocked (AIM-16). Endpoint evaluators may read tool_input locally to compute shape; only the decision (and optional shape metadata already allowed on the wire) leaves the host.

version.description: Schema major version. Bump only on breaking shape changes.

policy_id.description: Optional stable id for audit/ops (e.g. mcp-tool-arg-pilot-2026-08).

policy_hash.description: Optional content tag for audit continuity (same role as enforcement.policy_hash).

mode.description: observe = compute + audit only; enforce = endpoint may apply deny/confirm when the rail is flipped. Does not by itself flip unapproved-mcp-server.

default_effect.description: Effect when no rule matches. Prefer 'allow' so this policy is additive on top of the server allowlist (AIM-86/441).

rules.description: Ordered list. Highest priority among matching rules wins; ties break by list order (first wins).

notes.description: Human rationale for the revision. Never customer content.

effect.description: allow = permit; deny = hard block (when mode=enforce); confirm = challenge/resubmit gate (same UX family as pii-in-prompt / MCP break-glass).

nameMatcher.description: Exact string, or structured matcher. Glob-style '*' alone means any non-empty name.

typeClass.description: Value type class only. 'present' means key exists with any type. NEVER a value.

argShape.description: Argument *shape* constraints. Keys are argument names; types are JSON type classes. No value predicates allowed (additionalProperties:false).

keys_all.description: Every listed key must be present (type unconstrained unless key_types says otherwise).

keys_any.description: At least one listed key must be present.

keys_none.description: None of these keys may be present.

key_count.description: Bounds on the number of top-level argument keys.

key_types.description: Required type class per key. Implies key presence except for type 'present' which only requires existence.

priority.description: Higher wins among matching rules. Default 100.

title.description: Short operator-facing label (not shown to end users unless policy allows).

match.description: All present fields are AND-ed. Omitting a field means unconstrained.
